title: Teach a model to call my tools
blurb: Give it conversations that end in a tool call -- ml-stack-train-tools makes them from your tool schemas -- and a small chat model learns which tool a question wants and how to call it.

fields.name: steps
fields.label: How long to train
fields.help: A few hundred steps over a few hundred conversations is a pass or two. Watch the held-out score.

fields.name: context
fields.label: Longest conversation it reads
fields.help: Tokens. The tool declarations are rendered into every row: the five graph tools with their worked examples measured 1,080 tokens through functiongemma's template, and a row the context cuts off is dropped, not taught.

fields.name: learning_rate
fields.label: Learning rate
fields.help: A full fine-tune of a pretrained model wants a small one; 3e-3 is for training from scratch.
